{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy gate''', or '''energy fence''', was a device that employed a static or [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetic field]] to restrict access to high-security areas such as detention centers or [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]], or to areas contaminated by toxins or disease—such as was used to isolate the bioplague that afflicted a [[Isolation Sector|sector]] of the planet [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]]. Energy gates, sometimes composed of '''energy bars''', were generally operated from a distance. Similar to an energy gate in its technology was an [[energy cage]].
